title: Postern run response
description: Response body of POST /postern/v0/run, and the payload of the stream done event. See SPEC.md section 4.2. There is no status field: every failure routes through the error envelope on a non-2xx status, so this body exists only when the run succeeded.

run_id.description: Unique within the runner's lifetime; correlates with stream events and logs.

type.description: The output types a conforming implementation emits. text is the v0 type by decision (SPEC.md section 4.1.4), so value carries a string. A client MUST NOT use this enum to reject a response — and unlike every other unknown in this protocol, an unrecognised output type may not simply be ignored either: a client MUST NOT present value as text, MUST NOT report the run as failed, and SHOULD say which type it was given.

value.description: Concatenating every stream delta.text in order MUST equal this value.

usage.description: SHOULD be present when the runner can determine it.

cost_usd.description: Best estimate in US dollars. Advisory: a client MUST NOT treat this as a billed amount.
